spans.s:
जिघत्नु जिघत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. हन्), Ved.
endeavouring to hurt.

जिघांसक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. Desid. of rt. हन्),
wishing or endeavouring to kill, revengeful.

जिघांसा, f. wish or intention to strike, slay, or
destroy; malice, revenge.
जिघांसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, intending to kill.

जिघांसीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of the last),
more intent on slaughter, very desirous of killing.

जिघांसु, उस्, उस्, उ, intending or seeking to kill
or slay, desirous of destroying, malicious, murderous,
revengeful; (उस्), m. an unrelenting foe, an enemy.

जिघत्सत् जिघत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. Desid.
of rt. घस्), wishing to eat, hungry.
जिघत्सा, f. desire of eating, hunger, voracity.

जिघत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, hungry, voracious; (उस्), f.
an epithet of evil demons.

जिघृक्षत् जिघृक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or जि-
घृक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Desid. of rt. ग्रह्),
wishing or intending to take or seize, greedy,
avaricious.

जिघृक्षा, f. wish or intention to take or seize,
greediness, covetousness.

जिघृक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to
take or seize, covetous, avaricious; wishing to rob or
deprive of; wishing to take up (a fluid); wishing to
gather; wishing to learn.

जिघ्र जिघ्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. घ्रा), smell-
ing, a smeller; observing, conjecturing.
जिघ्रत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, smelling, smelling at.
